info.description: Create songs and lyrics, extend or transform tracks, manage supported personas and studio projects, and retrieve music or export formats with Suno. Start: https://platform.acedata.cloud/services/f2b646d8-3cfd-46ef-969a-1ea9eebde329?from=coze

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: Bind your own Ace Data Cloud credential privately as Bearer YOUR_API_TOKEN in Authorization. Usage is billed to your account. Never place a token in chat or shared examples.

bpm.description: Sound effect target speed (beats per minute), optional only when `action` is `sounds`, must be an integer from 1 to 300.

key.description: The target mood of the sound effect, optional only when `action` is `sounds`.

async.description: Whether to process in asynchronous mode. When set to `true`, the interface immediately returns `task_id`, without the need to provide `callback_url`, and then the result can be obtained by polling the corresponding task query interface; if `callback_url` is also provided, the result will be pushed to that callback address.

lyric.description: Lyrics for generating music under custom mode (`custom` is `true`). `chirp-v3-5` and `chirp-v4` have a maximum of 3000 characters; `chirp-v4-5` and above (including `chirp-v5`, `chirp-v5-5`) have a maximum of 5000 characters.

model.description: The model used for generating music has a default value of `chirp-v4`.

sound.description: The sound effect description to be generated, required when `action` is `sounds`.

style.description: Music style description. `chirp-v3-5` and `chirp-v4` up to 200 characters; `chirp-v4-5` and above (including `chirp-v5`, `chirp-v5-5`) up to 1000 characters.

title.description: Music Title (Custom Mode). `chirp-v3-5` and `chirp-v4` up to 80 characters; `chirp-v4-5` and above (including `chirp-v5`, `chirp-v5-5`) up to 100 characters.

action.description: Types of operations for generating music. `generate`: Generate audio based on prompts; `extend`: Continue generating based on existing audio; `concat`: Stitch existing audio clips into a complete track; `cover`: Copy the musical style of an existing track and reinterpret it; `upload_cover`: Style cover of uploaded audio; `upload_extend`: Extend and continue generating uploaded audio; `artist_consistency`: Sing new songs in the style of a specified artist (Persona); `artist_consistency_vox`: Sing new songs in the style of a specified artist using VOX mode; `stems`: Separate the song into vocal and accompaniment tracks; `all_stems`: Separate the song into all independent tracks (vocals, drums, bass, other instruments); `replace_section`: Replace segments within a specified time period; `underpainting`: Generate and add AI accompaniment to the uploaded vocal track; `overpainting`: Generate and add AI vocals to the uploaded accompaniment track; `samples`: Add AI samples to the uploaded audio within a specified time period; `remaster`: Remaster existing audio to enhance sound quality; `mashup`: Mix and stitch multiple songs into one track; `inspo`: Generate new music inspired by 1 to 4 reference audio segments.

custom.description: Whether to enable the custom mode flag. If `true`, the audio will be generated based on the lyrics; otherwise, it will be generated based on the prompts.

prompt.description: The prompt words for generating music in inspiration mode (when `custom` is set to `false`) must not exceed 500 characters. For custom mode, please use `lyric` and `style`.

variety.description: The diversity strength of the generated results, with optional values `off`, `normal`, `high`, `extra`, and `max`. Used for generation actions that support this capability; can be omitted when diversity control is not needed.

audio_id.description: Audio ID used for generating additional audio based on existing audio. This field is required when `action` is `extend` or `concat`.

duration.description: The expected song duration (in seconds) must be an integer, with a range of 10 to 360. This is used for song generation in custom mode (`custom` is `true`). It is a preference prompt rather than a strict constraint: the model will refer to this value but does not guarantee to meet it. The actual product duration is based on the `duration` field in the response, which is usually shorter than the expected value, and results from submitting the same request multiple times may also vary significantly.

max_mode.description: Whether to enable enhanced generation mode. `generate` is only enabled when both `custom` and `max_mode` are `true`, with a cost of 1.12 Credits; `add_stem` can be enabled directly, with a cost of 1.344 Credits. Do not pass in other actions.

stem_type.description: Track type. Required when `action` is `add_stem` or `extract_stem`; supports `vocals`, `backing_vocals`, `drums`, `bass`, `guitar`, `keyboard`, `percussion`, `strings`, `synth`, `fx`, `brass`, `woodwinds`.

weirdness.description: The "Weirdness" advanced parameter in the Suno official custom mode has a value range of 0 to 1, with higher values resulting in more creative and experimental outputs. It is only effective in custom mode.

audio_urls.description: A list of reference audio URLs for inspiration, requiring 1 to 4 publicly accessible audio addresses. This field is mandatory when `action` is `inspo`.

keep_pitch.description: Whether to maintain the original pitch when adjusting speed, required when `action` is `adjust_speed`.

persona_id.description: Generate the singer Persona ID used when creating songs based on the unique style characteristics of the specified singer.

sound_type.description: Sound effect type, required when `action` is `sounds`. `one-shot` indicates a one-shot sound effect, and `loop` indicates a loopable sound effect.

continue_at.description: Continue generating from the specified time point (seconds) of the existing audio. For example, 213.5 means to continue from 3 minutes and 33.5 seconds.

samples_end.description: Add the end time of the sample for the uploaded audio, which must be less than the total duration of the song.

audio_format.description: Output audio format, optional only when `action` is `extract_stem` or `sounds`; available options are `mp3`, `m4a`, and `wav`.

audio_weight.description: The weight of the uploaded reference audio, with a value range from 0 to 1, where a higher value indicates greater reliance on the reference audio. This only takes effect during the cover operation.

callback_url.description: Callback URL to be called after audio generation is complete.

instrumental.description: Pure accompaniment mode (no lyrics), default is `false`. When set to `true`, the lyrics filled in above will be ignored.

lyric_prompt.description: Prompts for automatically generating lyrics, effective only when `custom` is `true` and `lyric` is empty.

vocal_gender.description: Voice gender preference, selectable values are `'m'` (male voice) or `'f'` (female voice). Models `chirp-v4-5` and above are effective; this parameter is a preference item that can increase the probability of the target gender, but it does not guarantee strict adherence.

negative_tags.description: Descriptions of styles or genres that should not appear in the generated music will only take effect when the custom mode (`custom` is `true`).

samples_start.description: Add a default start time for the uploaded audio sample, with a default value of 0.

style_influence.description: The "Style Influence" advanced parameter in the Suno official custom mode has a value range of 0 to 1, with higher values being closer to the selected style. It is only effective in custom mode.

mashup_audio_ids.description: Audio ID list for mixing and mashup. This field is required when `action` is `mashup`.

overpainting_end.description: Add the end time of the AI voice to the uploaded audio, which must be less than the total duration of the song.

speed_multiplier.description: Playback speed multiplier, required when `action` is `adjust_speed`, ranging from 0.25 to 4.

underpainting_end.description: Add the end time for the AI accompaniment to the uploaded audio, which must be less than the total duration of the song.

overpainting_start.description: Set the default start time for the AI voice of the uploaded audio to 0.

variation_category.description: `variation_category` only supports version v5 and above, with only three optional values: `high`, `normal`, `subtle`.

replace_section_end.description: When `action` is `replace_section`, specify the end time (in seconds) of the segment to be replaced.

underpainting_start.description: Set the default start time for the AI accompaniment added to the uploaded audio, with a default value of 0.

replace_section_start.description: When `action` is `replace_section`, specify the start time (in seconds) of the segment to be replaced.

replace_section_result_mode.description: When `action` is `replace_section`, specify the return format. `full_song` (default) will concatenate 2 candidates separately and return 2 complete songs; `candidates` will return 2 uncombined replacement segment candidates, which need to be selected before calling `concat`.
